headline: HVANG94 STARTED NOBODY AT DEFENSE AND STILL WON. 6-1, BTW. 🫥🍀

sections.heading: THE EMPTY CHAIR AT DEFENSE 🫥
sections.body:
Hvang94 went shopping on Wednesday and bought the Dallas Cowboys defense. Then on Thursday the Panthers got cut for Kendre Miller. Then on Sunday Hvang94 started... nobody. The DEF slot on that Week 7 lineup is literally blank. An empty chair. A vacancy sign. 🪑

The Cowboys put up 4.90 on the bench. Hvang94 won by 2.11. LOL. Two weeks ago this team won by 0.66 with a MINUS 2.90 defense, and now it has discovered the next frontier of not trying: not having one at all. 🤡

Drake Maye bailed Hvang94 out with 31.44, Amon-Ra added 19.70, and Hvang94 is 6-1, alone in first, with a team literally named Not good, Just lucky. At this point the name isn't a joke, it's a disclosure. 📜

sections.heading: YMVTHEDAD LOST BY 2.11 WITH 20 POINTS IN A FOLDING CHAIR 😭
sections.body:
The team on the other side of the empty-chair game was YMVtheDAD, who had the best player in the whole league this week: Joe Burrow, 36.88. That should be a win. It was not a win. 💀

Why? Because Omar Cooper Jr. scored 20.00 on the YMVtheDAD bench while Germie Bernard started and posted 4.20. That swap alone is 15.80 points, in a game lost by 2.11. The optimal lineup was 136.03, the only one in the league this week that would have flipped a loss into a win.

Losing to a team that didn't start a defense, with a 37-point quarterback, because of a WR3 decision. You cannot write this stuff. Actually we just did. LOL. 🫠

sections.heading: CHRISTIAN KIRK, THE LEAGUE'S HOT POTATO 🥔
sections.body:
Christian Kirk had a week. Evz132 picked him up Thursday evening and cut him Friday evening. imbackbeech grabbed him in the early hours of Saturday and cut him by Saturday afternoon. Three teams, four transactions, one wide receiver nobody could commit to. 🔁

Then at 1:49 a.m. Eastern on Sunday, Keeneng scooped him up, dropped Isiah Pacheco to do it, and STARTED him. Kirk suited up, played, and scored a perfect 0.00. 🥚

Keeneng won by 11.28 anyway, because imbackbeech's Texans defense scored 0.05, which is somehow even less inspiring than a zero. Somewhere Kirk is wondering why everyone keeps picking him up and putting him down like sunglasses on a gas station rack. 🕶️

sections.heading: WAIVER WATCH: GENO GOT PAID, FOLK GOT REVENGE 💸
sections.body:
ChunckyM's Josh Allen was on bye, so on Wednesday evening ChunckyM cut Sam Darnold for Geno Smith off the street. Geno went 29.48. Free. Same evening: Zonovan Knight in for George Holani, Knight started for 7.80. Then Seth McGowan off the wire Thursday, started, 5.30. Perfect lineup, 108.58, a W by 15.87. That's how you churn. 🧠

VangMushu did the same QB trick with Jayden Daniels on bye: Kyler Murray off free agency, 15.90 as a starter. Didn't save the week, but it was a correct idea, which is rare enough in that building to deserve a mention. 🙏

And then there's KevinVang, who cut Nick Folk on Wednesday for Evan McPherson. McPherson scored 5.00 in the KevinVang lineup. Folk, unemployed, scored 10.00 for nobody. Last week Folk gave KevinVang 1.00, so we understand the impulse. We're just saying the kicker held a grudge. 🦵

Bonus: ChunckyM also dropped the Saints defense for the Titans. The Titans gave ChunckyM MINUS 0.70. The Saints, scooped up by jayvang100, gave 2.65. Even the defenses are taking sides. 😂

sections.heading: JAYVANG100 STARTED THE RIGHT QUARTERBACK 🫡
sections.body:
Back in Week 3 jayvang100 benched Brock Purdy for a third straight week while Purdy dropped 39.28. This week jayvang100 sat Purdy again and it was CORRECT: Dak Prescott 29.28, Purdy 14.02 on the pine. Growth. 🌱

Tony Pollard then went off for 35.00, the best non-quarterback score of the week, and the whole lineup landed at 144.63, top score in the league, only 1.80 points shy of perfect. Tonglue's 112.97 would have beaten eight other teams. It got beat by 31.66. 🚀

sections.heading: ONE AT 6-1, FIVE AT 4-3, FIVE AT 3-4, AND THE BASEMENT 📈
sections.body:
Hvang94 is 6-1 and alone on top while sitting second in points scored (781.26). ChunckyM is 5-2 and leads the league in points (807.20), which is the most respectable possible way to be in second. 🥈

Then a five-way pileup at 4-3: YMVtheDAD, Tub89, KevinVang, mouavang86 and cvang1990. Another five at 3-4: jayvang100, Tonglue, Keeneng, Evz132 and imbackbeech. Half the league is separated by one game. Nobody is safe. Everybody is nervous. 😬

muahuavang is 2-5 and has now absorbed 834.74 points against, the most in the league by a mile. VangMushu is 1-6 and alone in the basement. The Sacko has a front-runner and it's wearing a name tag. 🪦

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
Ranked by what you actually scored in Week 7. Your record can't save you here. 📋

1. jayvang100 — 144.63, won by 31.66. Dak Prescott 29.28 in the lineup, Brock Purdy's 14.02 on the bench, and for once that's the right call. Tony Pollard's 35.00 carried everybody and Brandon Aubrey's 14.00 came within 0.70 of Bijan Robinson's 14.70. 🏆

2. Hvang94 — 119.44, won by 2.11. Drake Maye 31.44, Amon-Ra 19.70, and an empty DEF slot while the Cowboys put up 4.90 on the bench. Wins by 0.66 and 2.11 in the last three weeks and somehow this is a 6-1 team. 🍀

3. YMVtheDAD — 117.33, LOST by 2.11. Joe Burrow 36.88, top score of the week by anyone. Omar Cooper Jr. scored 20.00 on the bench while Germie Bernard started for 4.20, and the Jets defense chipped in MINUS 0.55, so this L was handmade. 😭

4. Tub89 — 116.17, won by 29.24. Quinshon Judkins 22.90 and CeeDee Lamb 21.90 did the heavy lifting. Bo Nix scored 28.28 on the bench while C.J. Stroud started for 20.52, and the 49ers defense went MINUS 3.65, so it was a comfy win with two very visible holes in it. 🛋️

5. KevinVang — 114.40, won by 41.43, the biggest blowout of the week. Kirk Cousins 24.40 and Tre Tucker 18.80, near-perfect lineup with 0.80 left on the bench. The only stain: cut Nick Folk for McPherson, and Folk scored 10.00 to McPherson's 5.00. 💥

6. Tonglue — 112.97, LOST by 31.66. Cut an injured Jalen Hurts, started Michael Penix Jr. for 26.42, and Skattebo (18.60) plus Emanuel Wilson (18.00) showed up. Garrett Wilson's 3.60 and A.J. Brown's 6.30 didn't, and the sixth-best score in the league ran into the first-best. 🚂

7. ChunckyM — 108.58, won by 15.87. Perfect lineup, zero points left on the bench. Geno Smith off the street for 29.48, Jaxon Smith-Njigba 26.80, Luther Burden 21.70. Kicker Eddy Pineiro scored 1.00 and the Titans defense scored MINUS 0.70, so even the perfect lineup had a little garbage in it. 🧹

8. mouavang86 — 102.85, won by 19.40. Patrick Mahomes scored 6.00, and the Steelers defense outscored him with 8.25 — second straight week the Pittsburgh D beat Mahomes. Jameson Williams 23.60 saved the day, while Dameon Pierce's 11.30 sat behind Jalen Coker's 1.40. 🙃

9. Keeneng — 95.15, won by 11.28. Zay Flowers 23.70 and Stafford 23.50 with Trevor Lawrence on bye, so no QB dilemma for once. Then Keeneng picked up Christian Kirk at 1:49 a.m. Eastern and started him for 0.00 while Courtland Sutton's 6.00 sat. Derrick Henry: 5.40. A win is a win. 🥚

10. Evz132 — 92.71, LOST by 15.87. Perfect lineup! Mostly because all seven bench players scored exactly 0.00, including Brian Thomas Jr., added in the wee hours of Sunday during a Jaguars bye week. Trey McBride's 22.10 was real; Brandin Cooks' 1.80 at flex was not. 🫥

11. cvang1990 — 86.93, LOST by 29.24. Tee Higgins 23.80 and Aaron Rodgers 15.08 holding things down with Lamar out. KC Concepcion scored 19.20 on the bench while Jaylin Noel started for 0.70, and that one decision cost 18.50 points. 🪑

12. imbackbeech — 83.87, LOST by 11.28. Goff 22.02 and Javonte Williams 21.50 were fine. The Texans defense scored 0.05, Aaron Jones gave 3.10, and imbackbeech owned Christian Kirk for about twelve hours, which in hindsight was the smartest thing anyone did with Kirk all week. 🥔

13. VangMushu — 83.45, LOST by 19.40. Started Emeka Egbuka, who was ruled out, for a clean 0.00. Credit where due: Kyler Murray off the wire for 15.90 and the Vikings defense (10.25) over the Eagles (MINUS 8.30 on the bench) was a great call. Still 1-6. 🪦

14. muahuavang — 72.97, LOST by 41.43. Caleb Williams did his part with 26.12, then Nico Collins scored 1.60 and TreVeyon Henderson started for 3.30 while Rico Dowdle's 11.60 sat. 834.74 points against and counting. Somebody check on this team. 🫂
